vetSays.line: 🛡️ DeShawn, Rocco, Phensri, Rolando and Farid met them at the door — 5 put down. DeShawn, Rocco, Phensri, Rolando, Farid are hurt.
🛡️ Rocco, Phensri, Farid, James and Ella met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Rocco didn't come back. Phensri, Farid, James, Ella are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Phensri, Rolando, Farid, James and Oliver met them at the door — 5 put down. Phensri, Rolando, Farid, James, Oliver are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nikos just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? James just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Oliver just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ivy just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Farid, James, Oliver and Ivy met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 barely walked away. Farid, James, Oliver, Ivy are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? James just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ivy just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Farid taught everyone about European Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Fireside lesson: Farid passes around European Elder. Someone asks a dumb question. Nobody minds. That's how you learn.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Oliver just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Elif just put down Loud-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🌿 European Elder — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 European Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.
SYSTEM: "That was... a lot. The producers say the ratings were historic. I don’t know what to do with that sentence."
🛡️ Benoit, Srisuda, Raul and Klaudia met them at the door — 1 put down, 3 barely walked away. Benoit, Srisuda, Raul, Klaudia are hurt.

opens.openerLine: "What's the most useful thing you've learned since we got here? Funny how that works."
"Did you sleep? I kept hearing things out past the treeline."
"I've been turning something over. What do YOU think actually happened to us? That's the whole of it."
"I'm not sure, but What are you hoping for? Not the big stuff. The small thing."
"Hey." Nikos settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to."
"Can we talk?" Phensri sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to."
"About what you're hoping for — What are you hoping for? Not the big stuff. The small thing. Just my read."
"You talk to it -- the System. Have you ever asked? About the taken -- about Malaya?"
"Can I tell you something? Before the scattering, I froze when it mattered. I think about it every day."
"About what happened to my taken kin — I keep dreaming about rows of pods. Humming. Tell me I'm not the only one."
"What's your first memory? Like, ever. The earliest thing."
"What do you make of all this? Really."
"We're eating through stores faster than we replace them. Come forage with me tomorrow — two of us can fill packs."
"We're eating through stores faster than we replace them. Forage with me tomorrow? I know the south slope below the meadow."
"I hate to ask, but do you have anything to eat? Anything at all? My hands shake when I try to work."
"When's the last time you really laughed?"
"Pantry's thin and getting thinner. Will you forage with me tomorrow? Two pairs of eyes, twice the ground."
"About the pantry run — the need hasn't gone anywhere. I'm still asking."
"About what you make of all this — What do you make of all this? Really."
"Can I tell you something? At night I talk to someone who isn't there anymore."
"What got you through the first week? The very first days."
"About the last time you laughed — When's the last time you really laughed?"
"They'd tell me to keep working. So I'm working. That's the whole plan."
"Can we talk?" James shifts their weight. "I need something to do. Anything. Please."
"I'm going hungry — do you have anything to eat? Anything at all? My hands shake when I try to work."
"About the food I needed — the need hasn't gone anywhere. I'm still asking."
Theo: "I've heard good things about Thornfield. We should link with them — we'd be stronger together."
"So what's your plan here? Just... get through it?"
"Can I tell you something? I've been sneaking out at night. I'm ashamed and I can't stop. No point pretending otherwise."
"Can I tell you something? I stole medicine from the stash once and never confessed."
"About your plan here — So what's your plan here? Just... get through it?"
Phensri: "Don't just stand there — you've got opinions, right?"
"Is there someone here you don't trust? Be honest."
"I keep dreaming about rows of pods. Humming. Tell me I'm not the only one."
"Have you heard anything? About the taken. The pods. Anything at all."
"It's quiet today. Wrong kind of quiet."
"Yeah — Every laugh out there feels wrong today. Then I feel wrong for thinking it."
"I keep expecting to see them by the fire. Then I remember."
"This cut — I can't clean it properly one-handed. Will you help me clean it?"
"Got a read on anyone here yet? Who should I be watching?"
"Never mind this wound — we got it handled. Thanks anyway."
"About what happened to my taken kin — You talk to it -- the System. Have you ever asked? About the taken -- about Malaya? Not that it matters."
"Can I tell you something? At night I cry quietly so no one hears."
"About your read on people here — Got a read on anyone here yet? Who should I be watching?"
"You talk to it -- the System. Have you ever asked? About the taken -- about Benicio? Simple as that."
"Do you still sing? ...Sorry — weird question. I just realized I haven't heard anyone sing."
"About whether you still sing — Do you still sing? ...Sorry — weird question. I just realized I haven't heard anyone sing."
"About what happened to my taken kin — I keep dreaming about rows of pods. Humming. Tell me I'm not the only one. Anyway — how are YOU doing?"
"Water's almost gone — 1 liters. I can't carry enough alone. First light, the creek, you and me?"
"About your read on people here — Got a read on anyone here yet? Who should I be watching? But what do I know."
"About your read on people here — Got a read on anyone here yet? Who should I be watching? Just... be straight with me."
"About the creek water run — still need hands. Are you in?"
"The cistern's nearly dry — 7 liters left. I can't carry enough alone. First light, the creek, you and me?"
"Have you heard anything? About the taken. The pods. Anything at all. Seen worse."
"About what happened to my taken kin — I keep dreaming about rows of pods. Humming. Tell me I'm not the only one."
"About the creek water run — I hate to ask twice, but it's still open. Will you?"
"About the creek water run — the need hasn't gone anywhere. I'm still asking."
"I asked Grayson about the creek water run — Grayson's gone. Still need hands. Are you in?"
"Why do you ask? Every laugh out there feels wrong today. Then I feel wrong for thinking it."
"Have you — sorry. I keep thinking about them."
"Don't mind me. Today's just heavy."
Farid: "I've heard good things about The Hungry Road. We should link with them — we'd be stronger together."
"The cistern's nearly dry — 8 liters left. I need someone to haul water with me at first light. Two of us, half the trips. Will you come?"

"Never mind the pantry run — we got it handled. Thanks anyway. The cistern's nearly dry — 7 liters left. I need someone to haul water with me at first light. Two of us, half the trips. Will you come?"
"About the creek water run — I still haven't found anyone. Any chance?"
"Can we talk?" Elif sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to."
"Can I tell you something? I'm practicing what I would say if I ever saw my family again. I haven't told anyone."
"About the taken — about Malaya. I can't stop turning it over. Have you heard anything new?"
Home wasn't a building. It was a feeling. I'm chasing the feeling.
"Never mind the creek water run — we got it handled. Thanks anyway."
"Are you angry? At whoever did this. At the sky. At anything."
"About whether you're angry — Are you angry? At whoever did this. At the sky. At anything."
"Every laugh out there feels wrong today. Then I feel wrong for thinking it."
"I asked Nikos about whether you're angry — Nikos's gone. Are you angry? At whoever did this. At the sky. At anything…"
"I asked Farid about whether you're angry — Farid's gone. Are you angry? At whoever did this. At the sky. At anything. ...sorry."
"About whether you're angry — Are you angry? At whoever did this. At the sky. At anything. Happy?"
"We gave them a good burial. Doesn't feel like enough, does it?"
"Mind if I just sit with you for a bit? Ha. Funny."
"What did you do for fun? Before. The thing you'd do on a perfect Saturday."
"About what you did for fun — What did you do for fun? Before. The thing you'd do on a perfect Saturday."
"...Hi. Sorry. I'm not good at the talking-to-strangers part. Good talking."
Everyone gets forgotten eventually. I'm negotiating for later rather than sooner.
Elif: "I've heard good things about Ashford. We should link with them — we'd be stronger together."
"Can I tell you something? I have been lying about my age — I'm younger than I look."
"About what you did for fun — What did you do for fun? Before. The thing you'd do on a perfect Saturday. I mean it."
"I can't reach this properly. Will you help me clean it?"
"I asked Elif about this wound — Elif's gone. Still need hands. Are you in?"
"About this wound — I hate to ask twice, but it's still open. Will you?"
"About this wound — the need hasn't gone anywhere. I'm still asking."
"About this wound — I still haven't found anyone. Any chance?"
"About this wound — still need hands. Are you in?"
I dream about finding them. Then I wake up and the dreaming feels like the real part.
"People are smiling. I forgot what that looked like."
My sister was in rural Ireland when the sky changed. I don't know if — I have to believe she's out there.
I keep their faces in my head like photographs. If I stop looking, I might lose them.
Someone out there knows something. I just have to find the right someone.
Every stranger on the road could know something. I ask. I always ask. You would too.
Family isn't just blood. But blood's a good place to start looking.
I'd walk through anything to get to them. That's not courage. That's just... math.
I'm not staying here forever. The moment I can travel, I'm going looking.
Klaudia: "Hey. I want to ask it plain: will you be my bonded friend? I'll watch your back if you watch mine."
"I keep dreaming about rows of pods. Humming. Tell me I'm not the only one."

lines.line: (Talking costs a little energy — 10 kcal a conversation. Small talk is cheap; going deep costs time, not more food.)
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
